## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the behavior after this change, and the related issue.

## Validation

List checks and exit codes. Link sanitized lab evidence for runtime claims.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests were written before behavior changes.
- [ ] Relevant quality gates pass; remaining limits are stated above.
- [ ] Security and session-authority invariants remain intact.
- [ ] Files stay within 400 lines; comments explain why; no TODO or nolint suppressions.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog describe user-visible changes.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
